notes: Microsoft Foundry Global Standard public preview with the same generation and editing capabilities as MAI-Image-2.6, optimized for lower cost and faster generation.

The mai-image route defaults to /mai/v1/images/generations on the Foundry services endpoint. Set targetModel to the actual deployment name; explicit upstream route and host overrides remain available.
Generation uses width and height; the profile expands explicit WIDTHxHEIGHT size values. Native auto_aspect_ratio and web_grounding parameters are preserved for upstream handling.

The upstream returns base64 PNG data. Native image edits use multipart requests through mai-image-edits at /mai/v1/images/edits, enabled by media.http.enabled. Generation size expansion is not applied to edits.
maxInputTokens, maxOutputTokens remain independently unverified for this exact deployment/endpoint. No token ceiling is inferred from a sibling model, billing unit, or subtraction of other limits.

The exact Azure model meters independently price text input, image input and image output; unpublished cache or text-output rates remain absent. pricingCatalogEntry=null is retained so this metadata update does not enable scalar text billing for media.

Verified 2026-11-06 against Azure Retail Prices API serviceName='Foundry Models', productName='MAI Models', using exact-model Global consumption meters and their published units. Batch, Flex, Priority, Data Zone and negotiated discounts are not selected. Existing pricingCatalogEntry opt-outs are retained.
